reason: a destination's size cap cut this content before it was stored (weft.content.truncated_bytes)
fix: raise the destination's cap: otel.Content(otel.ContentConfig{MaxBytes: …}), -1 for unlimited

log_cap.reason: the app-log reader's candidate cap was reached before attribution; later lines of this run may be missing
log_cap.fix: log less in the run's trace (a busy subagent or sibling run counts too); phase 2 filters by span before the cap

metadata_cap.reason: metadata pairs over the core's limits were dropped whole
metadata_cap.fix: send fewer or smaller pairs (weft.Metadata: 64 keys, 128-byte keys, 1 KiB values)

response_cap.reason: this response reads a bounded number of steps and the run has more: the later steps were not compared, nothing was lost
response_cap.fix: open the later steps one by one (runs/{id}/steps/{n})

result_cap.reason: a tool result was cut by its result cap: the model saw a prefix and the marker

reason: content not captured by this app: the destination's chain stripped it (weft.content = stripped), or the agent captured none (weft.Content(false), weft.content = none), so prompts, catalogs, messages, tool arguments and results were dropped before they were stored
fix: turn content on: drop otel.NoContent() from the destination, or weft.Content(false) from the agent

reason: the destination's Redact hook rewrote this content before it was stored
the step finished on the output token limit: the response was cut
the run stopped reporting: no finish arrived and nothing was heard from it for over 30 s
a record the run counts is missing: a destination dropped it on the way
fix: raise the destination's queue: otel.QueueSize(n) on it (Studio's default 16,384), or otel.Blocking() under WEFT_ENV=dev; the app's WARN "weft/otel: destination queue full" names the destination, and weft doctor prints the drops Studio heard of (weft.records.dropped)

events_lost.reason: the core emitted more event records than were stored (weft.run.events on the run's root span): a destination dropped them on the way, its queue full or an export failed
events_lost.fix: raise the destination's queue: otel.QueueSize(n) on it (Studio's default 16,384), or otel.Blocking() under WEFT_ENV=dev; the app's WARN "weft/otel: destination queue full" names the destination, and weft doctor prints the drops Studio heard of (weft.records.dropped)

tail_lost.reason: the run's root span ended but its run_finish record never arrived: a destination dropped the record tail, so the last steps' records are missing
tail_lost.fix: the spans arrived, the records behind them did not: raise the destination's queue: otel.QueueSize(n) on it (Studio's default 16,384), or otel.Blocking() under WEFT_ENV=dev; the app's WARN "weft/otel: destination queue full" names the destination, and weft doctor prints the drops Studio heard of (weft.records.dropped)

reason: the record did not exist in the weft that wrote this run (v0.9.0 or earlier keeps no request, prompt or tools records, ADR 0028): nothing was lost, there was nothing to keep

no_logger.reason: the app exported spans only: this run's spans arrived but none of its records did, so it has no events, transcript or request records
no_logger.fix: wire the logs too: pass weft.LoggerProvider(lp) beside weft.TracerProvider, or use otel.Install (it wires both)

no_public_id.reason: the session's turns carry no weft.public_id (a thread session is created without thread.PublicID)
no_public_id.fix: thread.Create(…, thread.PublicID(id)), or set weft.public_id on every turn

no_spans.reason: the run was recorded without a tracer, so attempt spans and the answering model were not stored

not_served.reason: this Studio does not serve the request record (no requests capability): the run may hold one
not_served.fix: open the run in a Studio that serves it (upgrade Studio, or enable the requests group)

raw_off.reason: no wire bodies were recorded for this attempt: otel.RawBodies is off (the default, and refused outside WEFT_ENV=dev), or the adapter does not report them
raw_off.fix: run under WEFT_ENV=dev with otel.RawBodies(true) and a first-party adapter (an injected google client is not captured)

reason: computed by the reader, not stored as emitted: the record that would say it is absent

stock_spans.fix: the producer exports stock OTel GenAI spans only: emit weft's records (docs/record-contract.md) for events, the transcript and requests

reason: your token's scope may not read this: a read-scoped panel token does not read system prompts or tool catalogs

dev_token_only.reason: a panel token is scoped to one public id and may not look up a session's: this route answers the dev token only
dev_token_only.fix: ask with the server (dev) token, or use the public id the panel token was minted for

reason: the model saw a compacted view: compaction replaced part of the transcript for this request
